scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:lambdas && npm run build:applications
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/integrations && npm run build -w packages/risk-engine
scripts.build:applications: npm run build -w api-service -w cdk -w ui
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w api-service
scripts.build:cdk: npm run build:packages && npm run build:lambdas && npm run build -w cdk
scripts.build:lambdas: npm run build -w lambdas/collector -w lambdas/incremental-collector -w lambdas/list-accounts -w lambdas/graph-writer -w lambdas/policy-evaluator -w lambdas/cloudtrail-analyzer -w lambdas/dspm-scanner -w lambdas/least-privilege-sweep -w lambdas/runtime && npm run build:lambda -w packages/risk-engine
scripts.package:lambdas: npm run build:packages && npm run build:lambdas && bash scripts/package-lambdas.sh
scripts.ci:lint: npm run format:check && npm run lint
scripts.ci:quality: npm run ci:lint && npm run ci:typecheck && npm run ci:test && npm run ci:build && npm run package:lambdas && npm run smoke:lambdas
